title: EE60021: Power Transmission Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Transmission line Trends and preliminaries, Corona effects - Power loss and
audible noise, Radio interference. Electrostatic field of EHV lines. General
comparison of A.C. and D.C. transmission, AC\DC converters and components,
control and protection for HVDC systems. Reactive power management. Integrated
AC-DC systems. Multi-terminal D.C transmission. Flexible AC transmission
systems-concept and devices.
